learning_outcomes.text: Possess knowledge about basic concepts related to communication
Define basic concepts related to the field of Communication Sciences.
Know the historical development of communication processes and tools.
Possess knowledge about the function, purpose, and application of communication.
Know and be able to apply communication types.
Express the communication process and the characteristics of the elements involved in the process.
Use communication effectively.
Understand and be able to apply the importance of listening in communication.
Grasp communication barriers and the ability to solve them.
Determine the importance of culture within the communication process.
Effectively apply the elements necessary for effective speech.
Develop verbal, non-verbal (body language), written, visual, and electronic communication skills.
Possess knowledge about basic concepts related to organizational communication.
Analyze communication processes they witness.
Gain awareness about their own communication styles.
Possess knowledge about organizational communication types and their functioning.
Initiate necessary changes in their own communication styles.
Develop healthy communication skills in conflict situations.
Evaluate which type of communication to use in every area of life.
Use non-verbal communication methods.
Understand the importance of ethical principles for individual and societal purposes throughout life, regarding acquired knowledge, skills, and competencies.

syllabus_topics: READING (SKIMMING, SCANNING, CAREFUL READING, FLEXIBLE READING, SPEED READING)
Communication skills and personality analysis test applications
Making a good impression on people
assessment_rules: Midterm and final exam dates are determined by the University Senate decisions and announced in the academic calendar.
